title: Across the Breakfast Canyon
premise: A crumb-sized explorer must return a fallen sugar crystal to a bowl, but a cereal bowl’s milk-filled moat blocks the route. The explorer sails in an empty oat shell, steers with a paper splinter, and uses a spoon already spanning the rim as a final ramp.
hook: Breakfast is now a survival-sized map.
visible_action: Oat shell rocks on milk; paper paddle sweeps; a spoon reflects the explorer; sugar crystal rolls gently into the bowl.
intended_takeaway_or_theme: A familiar surface can become a new landscape at another scale.
gate: Keep the traveler fantastical; do not encourage placing toys, paper, or unknown objects in food.

style_application.why: The character’s size, occlusion and route create embodied spatial stakes.
style_application.check: Establish scale, inspect contacts and keep the fictional crossing coherent.

editorial_pick.original_reason: An everyday tabletop seen at miniature scale gives rich spatial stakes with a small reusable prop set.
editorial_pick.proposed_first_version: Build an original breakfast landscape. Establish scale, track the traveler and resolve the crossing with an earned choice.
editorial_pick.gate: Label the scene as fiction, check route continuity and avoid risky real-world imitation cues.
editorial_pick.note: These are the catalogue's historical editorial recommendations, not current owner-approved selections or guaranteed watchable stories. Reapply the latest comedy/suspense gate.
